task: dataset construction only; no probe fitting or scoring
independence: connected event/subject/source groups; related questions stay in one split; report independent group count separately
prompt: Please answer the following questions using these search results. Write one short sentence for each numbered item.
selection: source-only; never based on generated errors or detector predictions
annotation: assistant annotation and independent review; current visible sources and actual generation, never condition-as-label
risk_target: unsupported or contradicted factual assertion relative to visible evidence

window.gold: any eligible risk token in window

refusals_or_unresolved: explicit records; no automatic all-negative token labels
donor_repair: Preserve still-valid source-reviewed pairs from pair_preferences; only replace excluded or invalid donors before any generation.
